request: Organize the donation receipts, pledge schedule, donor-advised fund grants, in-kind acknowledgment letters, recurring payment records, restriction notes, and missing charity confirmations I supplied for 2026. Do not value gifts, give tax advice, contact charities, or decide deductibility.
scope: Donors, household finance helpers, bookkeepers, and nonprofit staff reconciling charitable-giving records while donors and qualified tax professionals retain decision authority.

evidence.title: Gift, payment, receipt, and acknowledgment register
evidence.summary: Every gift, payment, receipt, restriction, pledge, in-kind item, reversal, conflict, and missing confirmation is represented with provenance

evidence.title: Pledge, restriction, donor-advised-fund, and in-kind evidence ledger
evidence.summary: Valuation, deductibility, substantiation, filing, and charity-contact questions remain assigned to the donor or qualified human

blockers.reason: Do not provide tax, legal, accounting, valuation, deductibility, or substantiation advice
